shared_elements: rows of short repeated parallel strokes (comb-like hatching)
schematic outline forms stacked one above another
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry schematic outlined motifs combined with bands or rows of short repeated parallel strokes, and both stack several motifs one above another on the surface. Otherwise the content is quite different  fB shows an explicit register scheme of recognisable creatures (quadrupeds in a row, birds with long necks and beaks, snakes, a fox-like animal) rendered in modelled relief, while A shows abstract curvilinear/comb forms resembling boats or fringed arcs with no clearly identifiable animals or figures.
